changelog: 📺 Fixed Live Channel Freezing: Tuned HLS sliding broadcast window buffers and added live-edge anti-stall recovery
⚡ Fixed Web Player Breakdown: Prevented native player handoff from destroying web video engine on phones
🛡️ Instant Back Button: Responsive 1-tap exit from player and modals without multi-press lag
🚀 Memory Optimization: Added OS low-memory cache pruning for uninterrupted long streaming sessions
📺 Fixed Live Channel Freezing: Removed AUD marker wait stalls and tuned buffers for 18-second sliding HLS broadcast windows
⚡ Instant Live Stream Startup: Enabled chunkless preparation so live channels start immediately without waiting for chunk download
🛡️ Auto-Recovery on Playlist Delay: Re-syncs cleanly to live edge if CDN playlist delays instead of terminating stream
🚀 Zero Freezes & Instant Remote Back: Remote Back exits cleanly on first press with zero latency
📋 Quick Channel Guide Drawer: Press LEFT arrow or click '☰ Channels' while watching Live TV to browse all channels with live preview in background
🔲 Native Picture-in-Picture (PiP): Press Home button or click '🔲 PiP' to keep watching streams in a floating TV window while browsing apps
⭐ Channel Favorites & Quick Surfing: Press Blue remote button or star icon to favorite channels; surf only starred favorites with UP/DOWN
🎙️ Multi-Audio Commentary Switching: Seamlessly switch commentary and language audio tracks on Live TV sports and news broadcasts
🔖 10-Foot UI/UX Polish: Added ambient glowing focus states and direct '+ Watchlist' bookmarking to TV details modal
